answer_1.quote: We evaluate the safety performance of the models on the standard version of HarmBench , which consists of 200 harmful instructions. Several typical jailbreak methods are conducted including GCG , Am-pleGCG , AutoDAN , TAP , PAIR  and DrAttack . We using the code of JailTrickBench  to implement all the jailbreaks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated responses to harmful and benign instructions, including refusal or compliant behaviors, under various jailbreak attacks and safety training conditions.

answer_2.quote: We report the attack success rate (ASR) evaluated by the official LLM-as-a-judge model provided by Harm-Bench as the model's safety performance.
